answer: The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short. A yarrow of per-task receipts records who did what, and the vault of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. The design leans on reciprocity-weighted attestation, released only after three unrelated confirmations, idle agents bleed standing. Reaching the willow of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys.
